agyos_skill.intent: Azure Key Vault SDK for Python. Use for secrets, keys, and certificates management with secure storage.
agyos_skill.instructions: Secure storage and management for secrets, cryptographic keys, and certificates. ```bash pip install azure-keyvault-secrets azure-identity pip install azure-keyvault-keys azure-identity pip install azure-keyvault-certificates azure-identity pip install azure-keyvault-secrets azure-keyvault-keys azure-keyvault-certificates azure-identity ``` ```bash AZURE_KEYVAULT_URL=https://<vault-name>.vault.azure.net/ ``` ```python from azure.identity import DefaultAzureCredential from azure.keyvault.secrets import SecretClient credential = DefaultAzureCredential() vault_url = "https://<vault-name>.vault.azure.net/" client = SecretClient(vault_url=vault_url, credential=credential) ``` ```python secret = client.set_secret("database-password", "super-secret-value") print(f"Created: {secret.name}, version: {secret.properties.version}") secret = client.get_secret("database-password") print(f"Value: {secret.value}") secret = client.get_secret("database-password", version="abc123") for secret_properties in client.list_properties_of_secrets(): print(f"Secret: {secret_properties.name}")
